meta.title: Recreate Order: Attempt to create order with Evaluation Duration left empty

plan.title: Recreate Order Validation Without Evaluation Duration

steps.note: Open the prepared closed RFQ summary with an existing vendor bid.
Open the RFQ Settings menu and launch the Recreate Order window.
Set the event end-time duration to 30 as required by the scenario.
Set the required future delivery date.
Attempt creation with Evaluation Duration deliberately left empty.
Assert the validation message identifies the missing evaluation duration.
Assert that the Recreate Order window remains open after the refused submission.
